items.exampleEn: I stay home on rainy days.
The cat is sleeping in the sunshine.
It is snowy in the mountains.
It is cloudy, but it is not raining.
There is a big tree in our yard.
items.exampleZh: 我們院子裡有一棵大樹。

items.sentenceEn: The cat is sleeping under the tree.

items.audioEn: It is cloudy now, but it will be sunny this afternoon.
items.audioZh: 現在是陰天，但今天下午會放晴。

items.sentenceEn: My pet dog loves the sunshine.
items.sentenceZh: 我的寵物狗很喜歡曬太陽。

items.sentenceEn: We sit by the fire on snowy nights.
items.sentenceZh: 下雪的夜晚，我們坐在火爐旁。

items.stemEn: Take an umbrella. It is ____ today.
A dog or a cat can be a good ____.
items.stemZh: 狗或貓都可以是很好的寵物。

items.passageEn: The weather is different in every place today. In Taipei, it is rainy. In Tainan, it is sunny and hot. In the mountains, it is snowy and very cold. In Hualien, it is cloudy, but there is no rain.
items.passageZh: 今天每個地方的天氣都不一樣。台北下雨，台南晴朗炎熱，山上下雪、非常冷，花蓮是陰天，但沒有下雨。

rubricZh: 說天氣可用 It is＋形容詞（例如 It is sunny），也可寫 Today is sunny、It's a sunny day
sunny 是形容詞，不要寫成 It is sun

items.instructionZh: 用 pet 造一個句子，說說你養（或想養）的寵物。
rubricZh: pet 可放在動物名稱前（例如 a pet cat），也可單獨當名詞（例如 I have a pet）
動詞配合主詞（例如 I have、I want）
